datasets.name: Daily weather forecast
datasets.description: Open-Meteo model forecast, not observed historical weather. Use daily_variables [temperature_2m_max, temperature_2m_min, precipitation_sum], timezone Asia/Shanghai, and forecast_days 1–16. Shanghai coordinates: latitude 31.23, longitude 121.47. Do not request hourly/current variables with this daily mapping. Days are numeric query parameters, not values from the date column. Refresh requests new forecasts but values need not change on every request.

columns.label: Date
columns.description: Local date in the requested timezone.

columns.label: Maximum temperature
columns.description: Daily model forecast maximum, not an observation.

columns.label: Minimum temperature
columns.description: Daily model forecast minimum, not an observation.
